Hi Tom — great to meet earlier today. Quick recap from our 30-min discovery so we’re aligned and to ask for one quick confirmation from you. Attachment: redwood-discovery-recap.pdf

Top takeaways (from your side):
- Workloads: real-time summarization + customer-support re-ranking, peak concurrent sessions ~40, avg tokens/session ~450
- Target latency: <= 150ms p50 for short responses, burst tolerance during peak events
- Data requirements: tenant-isolated logs; sensitive PII must not leave your VPC for the pilot
- Success criteria: 20% reduction in response latency and 10% lower per-token cost vs current endpoint

What we proposed:
- 4-week pilot on a small dedicated pool (isolated capacity) with guardrails: KV cache enabled, model quantization profile for cost balance, and a lightweight eval set we’ll run weekly
- Redwood provides monitoring dashboards and a single-point contact for ops & security

Quick ask: can you confirm whether (A) this is still a priority for your Q2 roadmap and (B) whether you’re open to a May pilot start (week of May 6)? If helpful I can send a one-pager + a draft SOW for procurement.

Next steps I recommend:
- You: confirm priority & pilot window (yes/no)
- Us: if yes, we send one-pager + draft SOW and schedule a 15-min kickoff to align stakeholders

Thanks — appreciate a quick reply either way.

Best,
Laura Bennett
